newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends firmer at 1,565-1,570 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends firmer at 1,565-1,570 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,565-1,570 per dollar in light interbank volume, a touch firmer from the morning's 1,565-1,575 due to low dollar demand, dealers said.
"Trade was thin today. The lev gained some five from the morning as foreign currency demand waned," one dealer said.
The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) was seen as the main foreign currency buyer in the market today, purchasing dollars at 1,565-1,570, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
The BNB has been seen as a net dollar buyer since the beginning of March, boosting its foreign exchange reserves and restraining a lev rise amid high dollar supply.
The BNB's foreign exchange reserves rose by some $110 million in March to $554.3 million, BNB figures showed. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
